Amy (People Ops): Heads-up — new contractor Lina (lina@example.com) is scheduled to start Mon 3/30. She's currently travelling and says background check completed but her proof-of-address upload is delayed. Also she may not be able to do an in-person office visit for ID verification on day 1. Can we coordinate a fallback for I-9 + laptop pickup?

Raj (Recruiter): I pinged Lina. She said she can arrive in SF between 9:30–11:00 on Mon if we can confirm someone to meet briefly. Otherwise she needs an alternate verification flow.

Kevin (IT): We can stage a laptop and do badge provisioning. Please fill the IT onboarding form: https://redwood.kb/internal/it-onboard (put "Lina pickup" in notes). I'll reserve a MacBook Pro 14" w/ asset tag A12345.

Sofia (People Ops): If she can make it in person, we do normal I-9 + badge check. If not, we can use the "authorized representative" affidavit process for remote verification — she signs the agent affidavit, we verify scanned ID and follow up within 3 business days. See checklist below.

Sofia (People Ops): ```I-9 fallback checklist:
- Candidate provides scanned photo ID (passport or DL) to hr@redwood.com
- Candidate signs Authorized Representative form and names agent (who will verify originals)
- Agent completes and signs Section 2 affidavit and returns by email
- People Ops logs exception and flags for in-person verification within 3 days of arrival
```

Raj (Recruiter): Lina prefers in-person if someone can meet her around 10am. I'll add a calendar invite and ask for a 20-min slot. @Kevin can you put the laptop on "Hold for Lina" at reception?

Kevin (IT): Done — laptop set to "Hold for Lina" at SF reception. Asset tag: A12345. Please put the candidate name on the pickup note.

hr-bot: Background check vendor (ClearCheck) status: PENDING — address verification. Action required: candidate to upload a utility bill or bank statement dated within 60 days. Link to upload sent to candidate: https://clearcheck.vendor/upload/xyz

Amy (People Ops): If the address doc doesn't arrive before Monday, we'll still proceed with onboarding but mark BG as pending and set tighter onboarding gating. Sofia, can you be the point for the I-9 agent/exception if needed?

Sofia (People Ops): I can. I'll meet Lina at SF reception at 10:00 if she confirms. If Lina can't make it, I'll start the authorized representative flow and send the agent affidavit template to Raj to forward.

Raj (Recruiter): Sending invite now and CCing Lina. Also adding a 9:40–10:00 buffer in case of travel delay. Security will issue temporary badge; Kevin please confirm badge access list: user-labs + 4th-floor.

Kevin (IT): Confirmed. Temporary badge access: user-labs, 4th-floor. Please remind Lina to bring a photo ID for reception.

Amy (People Ops): Perfect — I'll track the BG upload and the I-9 status. Quick note to team: keep photos/scans in the secure HR folder only (do not drop in slack). :thumbsup:

Raj (Recruiter): Noted. I'll update the candidate status in Greenhouse and comment on the requisition.

Sofia (People Ops): If anyone needs the affidavit template: https://redwood.com/hr/templates/agent-affidavit.pdf — I'll attach when needed.

Amy (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once BG is cleared or the authorized rep is completed. "
